name: SILL Entreprises
note: SAS (SIREN 636220220, Le Raden, Plouvien, capital EUR 18,830,562.30), which calls itself a longstanding family business; the club says the SILL was created in 1962 by the Falc'hun and León families. The company register lists Sébastien Floch as Président de SAS, with Tristan Falc'hun and Henri León as Directeurs Généraux.
